text: {"lessons":["I made no trades, so the account’s ups and downs came from holding my positions; I should review whether my overall risk and diversification still suit me.","The account fell substantially in periods 4–5, then recovered only partly; I should plan for drawdowns and avoid letting loss aversion drive impulsive decisions.","A short record of noisy market moves offers no reliable signal about what happens next, so I should avoid frequent trading and assess each position on its merits."]}
